note: Model-graded trigger-routing eval for the Microsoft (M365/D365/Power Platform/Copilot) skill family. For each prompt, the maestro layer should select expected_skill as the primary destination; near_miss lists plausible-but-wrong specialists that test disambiguation. expected_skill values must exist in catalog/skills.json.

evals.prompt: Before we turn on Microsoft 365 Copilot, how do we make sure it won't surface files people shouldn't see?
Design a Conditional Access baseline that requires phishing-resistant MFA for admins.
Our Power Platform environments are sprawling and DLP is weak; review business units and table permissions in Dataverse.
Are we ready to pass the Success by Design implementation review before our D365 project go-live?
Audit found users who can both create vendors and pay invoices in D365 Finance. Review the segregation-of-duties conflicts.
We finished one mock migration into D365 with matching record counts. Are we good to migrate to production?
Our month-end close in D365 Finance is slow and reporting is mistrusted. Where are the control gaps?
Inventory accuracy and master planning in D365 Supply Chain are off; review plan-to-produce.
Sellers don't trust the D365 Sales pipeline and the forecast is always wrong. Review revenue operations.
Cases are routed manually and SLAs keep breaching in D365 Customer Service. Review unified routing and SLAs.
First-time-fix is low and completed work orders aren't getting invoiced in D365 Field Service.
We bought lots of Copilot licenses but can't show ROI. How do we measure adoption and reclaim waste?
We deploy Power Platform solutions by hand and there's no rollback. Set up healthy ALM with pipelines.
We're building Copilot Studio agents with no governance or lifecycle. How do we control topics, actions, and publishing?
A business-critical Power Automate flow has one owner, broad sharing, and no error handling. Review the risk.

Tune our Azure Kubernetes Service autoscaler and right-size the node pools.
